paragraphs: Intellicampus sells an enterprise intelligence layer that connects institutional data and governs the AI tools departments buy. The homepage lists unifying data from SIS, LMS and CRM, giving that data institutional context, and creating a single source of truth that is ready for AI. The same page says the layer governs every AI agent that touches institutional data.

Stated outcomes include consolidating fragmented SaaS spend into a single governed intelligence layer and retiring redundant license fees. The homepage ties that data work to student support, saying interventions arrive too late when records are siloed and systems do not communicate. The platform is also positioned to replace expensive SaaS tools with agentic AI.

The about page traces the company to a higher education consulting firm whose clients it names as the Maricopa System, Miami Dade, Johns Hopkins and the Nevada State System. Design partners are described as institutions in the US and Australia. ServiceNow is named as recognizing the platform for higher education.

quote.text: We’re building the cognitive operating system for the modern university — one platform that brings it all together.
